name: Andrea Cavallaro
one_sentence_summary: Andrea Cavallaro leads the MINTS lab at EPFL, advancing multimodal intelligent systems across privacy-preserving AI, vision-language models, mechanistic interpretability, video anomaly detection, and multimodal perception for autonomous and robotic systems.
matrix_summary: Two new papers since the last update: a survey on **Mechanistic Interpretability of Deep Neural Networks** (arXiv Nov 2026) expanding MINTS's explainability research, and **Reproducible Multimodal Affordance Prediction** accepted at the ECCV 2026 HCMIW workshop. Citation counts for prior MINTS papers are climbing steadily (MM-HSD at 20, 6D Pose at 16), but no major institutional news.
